senses.gloss:
इदं॑रूप^1 a. thus shaped.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275.

इद॑म् (n. sgl. & ˚— as stem) this, this here (refers to
something following, rarely preceding);
 this all or this universe
(±वि॑श्वम्, स॑र्वम्, or सकलम्). Obs. also तदिदम् even this, this
very thing, किमिदम् what here? As adv. here;
 now, thus, even, right.
इद॑मिदम् here and there, now and then.
